lines: Ow-ow-ow... Hebiko's delicate lady legs are full of holes...
We had used Hebiko's tentacles to shield us from the enemy bullets, then we attacked them in the brief time after they were out of bullets and made our getaway.
With this tactic we had somehow managed to break through the drones that had been surrounding us.
B-But this place also looks different from before... Are we inside a tunnel?
Yeah, most likely it's an underground tunnel intended for laying cables when Tokyo Kingdom was built.
Ohh!? Then that means there's an exit somewhere!
Yeah... but I'm sure the UFS guys know that too...
An ominous metallic sound echoed through the tunnel.
That means there might be someone guarding the exit?
Yeah, I wanted to talk with you about how to deal with that... but looks like it's already too late.
Dark red metallic ants were loudly approaching, crawling all over the floor, the walls, and even the ceiling, each with a back-mounted machine gun trained on us.
Ghaieee!! Give us a break from the bullets!!!
You want Hebiko to be the shield again!? It's so awful though!!!!
Despite complaining, Hebiko stuck close to us, blocking the bullets with her octopus tentacles.
Alright, let's just get out of here like thisー
Another group of mechanical ants appeared, this time from the front, and surrounded us completely.
Is this an ant nest or what...!!?
The ants coming from behind us were also getting closer.
Hebiko can't protect both the front and back!!
The ants' bullets were flying at us from all sides.
When I slowly opened my eyes, bullets were being repelled in mid-air and sparks were crackling everywhere.
Oh shoot, my optical camouflage seems to have deactivated...
While muttering those words, a woman suddenly appeared, and her arms and heels snapped open to reveal hidden blades.
The world's superpowers were competing to develop cyborg technologies.
Enhancing a human with mechanical parts was a dangerous technology, said to be impossible without the help of Devildom medicine.
Can you not confuse me for a basic cyborg, please!? These are specially made Android Arms and Legs!!!
She yelled and pointed her left arm at the mechanical ants.
This time bullets shot out of her arm like a machine gun and destroyed the mechanical ants one after another.
The ants returned fire, but were quickly dispatched by the woman's steel limbs and powerful bullets.
Hey! What are you just standing around for!? Despite my appearance, this still hurts, so get out of here already!
Our sudden savior, the woman with the Android Arm. I had no idea what to make of her.
F-Fuma! What are you standing around for!? She's helping us!! So let's get the hell out of here!!!
Ah, right... uhmm... thanks, steel lady!

After the steel lady... after Asuka had destroyed all the mechanical ants coming from ahead, she made Hebiko, who had been protecting the rear, get out of the way and started attacking the ants on that side.
I can't explain why, but I can only help you with these guys. You'll have to take care of the rest by yourself.
You can't explain...!? Right, well anyway, it was a big help! Thanks!!
I didn't really understand, but with that strength, she surely wouldn't have an issue with the ants. We left steel lady Asuka behind and ran to search for an exit.
